title: Schooner Charley
specs: 60 foot gaff rigged steel vessel named Charley

services.name: Daily Sail
services.desc: Head out from Loon’s Foot Landing and hoist the sails for a 2 ½ hour excursion. We’ll set a course for the Big Lake or stay within the protected waters of the Duluth/Superior Harbor. Snacks and beverages

services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Board Schooner Charley for a private sailing experience for your group of up to 6

explain.meaning: The whole boat is booked for your group alone.

gap: Age or weight restrictions not stated
blurb: Guests sail Duluth, MN and Superior, WI from the water aboard a 60 foot steel schooner named Charley. Depending on weather, sails go on Lake Superior or down the harbor. Sails operate Fridays and Saturdays out of Loon’s Foot Marine in Superior, WI.
